purpose: Select the next separately measured candidate; not a speed or admission comparison.
checksum_limitation: FNV is a diagnostic checksum, not independent byte verification of each profiled output.

address_mapping.loop: N16 flat output, with uqadd.8h, ushr.8h and subhn/subhn2 narrowing followed by vector stores.
address_mapping.caution: Grouped sample lines show other offsets as ellipsis; listed dominant offsets are in the output loop. Counts locate work, not calibrated timing fractions.

next_candidate: Conservative N16 painted interval for page output only. Keep dense Buffer::output semantics and opaque-background admission.
deferred_candidate: Prepare N16 source words once per path; only21 named Buffer::path samples appear in this Exact workload, not all necessarily source conversion.
limitations: One retained current product only; there is no comparable baseline in this profile.
The long-lived process differs from short-lived paired confirmation samples.
Sampling covers whole-process work; RGBA FNV and printing are outside render timers but inside the sampled process.
The fixed attachment may include open/compile or may miss their completion; it is not a render-only sampling interval.
FNV checksums are derived from a previously independently byte-verified output; they do not replace pixel correctness checks.
Inlining and sample granularity limit attribution; absent named functions do not prove absent cost.
Requested sampling duration is not a guarantee of captured duration if the process exits early; retain raw sampler output and lifecycle flags.
No automatic retries, changing render count after inspecting stacks, or quantitative speedup claims.

static_reach.scope: Analytical source prediction assuming the fixed integer rectangle mask extents; not observed timing or instrumentation. Initialization, traversal and rasterization remain.
